scope_statement: This certificate records technical blockers that fail before any H4B arm can execute. Missing historical originals (D03/D04/D05/D06/D07/D16) are explicitly not treated as blockers and are not the reason for NOT_RUN.

observed_facts: H4A-0 APPROVED_INPUT_SET.json has initial_state_inputs=[], measurement_inputs=[], assumption_inputs=[].
H4A-1 ACTUAL_INPUT_MANIFEST.json lists three approved_but_unconsumed synthetic design records and consumed_by_model=[].
H4A-1 ACTUAL_INPUT_MANIFEST.json declares runtime_connected=false.
H4A-1 REVIEW.md:60 states the PASS does not authorize production initialization, measurement wiring, runtime connection, or any historical claim.
The experiment-admission CLI exits 0 with admission=EXPERIMENT_ONLY, historical_inputs_admitted=0, runtime_connected=false, errors=[].
grep of src/ shows no consumer of experiment_admission; the module never writes engine state.
what_it_does_not_mean: It is not a requirement for new historical originals.
It does not mean the approved experiment design is invalid; it means it is not wired.
The nine measurement mappings are definition-only; no missing value is an observed zero.
blockers.required_to_clear: A separately authorized initial-state/measurement integration with a real engine consumer and a runtime-connected manifest; not authorized in H4B.

applies_to: any claim that price/investment authority is executable
observed_facts: src/hsm_lab/institutions/execution_adapter.py::commit_proposal lines 363-371 accept only an exact ProcurementDecision; other decision types return is_committed=false with reason 'no existing TickControls mapping for this decision type; the minimal H2B bridge currently supports procurement requests'.
H2B REVIEW 'Known limits' confirms only ProcurementDecision is bridged; price, investment and household-need decisions report no existing TickControls mapping.

src/hsm_lab/engine/policy.py::compile_effective_policy lines 89-94 multiply every price by a global admin_price_factor; lines 100-102 scale hunger_base by a global investment_intensity. These are not per-category price authority or per-project approval.
src/hsm_lab/engine/finance.py::plan_investment lines 1611-1615 computes approved_new = min(requested, remaining_budget/unit_cost); there is no per-enterprise project-approval input.
src/hsm_lab/engine/material.py lines 1594-1605 forms new_request from endogenous capacity x hunger; it is not an institutional approval step.
PriceProposalDecision and InvestmentDecision schemas and H1B authority queries exist and are valid, but schema availability is not an execution path.
what_it_does_not_mean: A global scalar is not evidence of per-category price authority.
The existence of decision schemas does not mean the decisions can be committed.
The model has administrative commodity prices and household catalog recompilation; that is not price-category authority semantics.
blockers.required_to_clear: A separately authorized execution mapping for price-category and per-project investment decisions into the real kernel, with conservation and authority tests. Out of H4B whitelist.

applies_to: any claim that C0/C1 bytes are strictly identical
observed_facts: H3F-D3 REVIEW.md:8-11 and :75-80 record that the strict full-file C0/C1 byte criterion remains unmet; digests and identity verification pass, and digest preservation is not byte identity.
H4A-1 REPORT.md:177-195 keeps strict full-file bytes UNMET and does not create a waiver.
H4A-1 PLAN.md:75 forbids normalizing outputs, changing run ids/clocks/Git provenance, re-pinning, or citing a P06 waiver.
06 OMP handoff line 212 provides no exception for this step.
No applicable waiver was found.
blockers.this_step: New C0/C1 runs were executed only to verify frozen digest/identity. Canonical/checkpoint differential testing was NOT_RUN. The digest result does not close this blocker.
what_it_does_not_mean: Root-manifest exclusions, canonical equality, or digest equality are not strict byte equality.
The P06 reproduction waiver is not an H4 byte waiver.
blockers.required_to_clear: An authorized engineering fix or an explicit, applicable exception record; neither exists in this step.

applies_to: any use of H3G as evidence for H4B household transmission
observed_facts: H3G REPORT.md records a same-tick household realized/unmet structural null: forced-order sweeps of 1,000,000 units change edge deliveries by up to -13,776 units while household realized and unmet change by exactly 0.0.
H3G REPORT.md states production is exogenous and there is no recipe or investment optimization.
H3G REPORT.md claims 'Review verdict: PASS (independent reviewer)', but docs/phases/HIST_VNEXT/H3G/ contains only PLAN.md and REPORT.md; no REVIEW.md exists.
blockers.disposition: Record the existing structural null only in its original synthetic 4Q scope, and separately record the missing standalone independent review. Do not convert the report's self-claim into a verified PASS. Do not extrapolate the null to all later quarters and do not merge it with an unexecuted H4B null.
blockers.required_to_clear: A standalone independent H3G review or a new authorized H4B run. Neither is in this step.

applies_to: historical welfare interpretation of any executed arm
observed_facts: config/calibration/p06_clearance.json lines 22-29 record the F2 kernel closure audit failure: status collapsed, output_liveness 0.0.
Lines 48-58 keep the closure and frozen acceptance gates unsatisfied under the P06 reproduction-only scope.
This was not re-measured in H4B.
blockers.disposition: Retained as an existing snapshot. It is not a missing-original blocker, and the P06 reproduction waiver is not an H4 byte waiver. Even a non-zero local procurement first stage would not license a historical welfare interpretation of a collapsed F2 run.
blockers.required_to_clear: Not a thing H4B can clear; it is a standing interpretation limit.

not_blockers: Missing D03/D04/D05/D06/D07/D16 originals (recorded as evidence gaps, per H4 policy)
Empty approved-excerpt sets (recorded as no direct basis, not as evidence that no mechanism existed)
Missing 1972-76 precise dates/scopes (kept UNIDENTIFIED, not synthesized)
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not substitute the global admin_price_factor or investment_intensity for per-category/per-project authority.
Do not use the procurement-only bridge to stand in for price or investment execution.
Do not use a P06 waiver or digest equality to claim strict byte identity.
Do not turn a missing value or missing run into numeric zero.
Do not report a paired delta, first stage, trace, or resource profile that was not produced.
